description: This file defines the 'Article' class within the Opencart admin's controller event namespace. It contains methods to add, edit, and delete articles by scheduling relevant tasks via model calls.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: A controller class handling article-related events such as adding, editing, and deleting articles, primarily by queuing tasks.

methods.name: addArticle
methods.description: Schedules tasks to manage the addition of a new article based on output data.

methods.name: editArticle
methods.description: Schedules tasks to handle editing an existing article identified by args[0].

methods.name: deleteArticle
methods.description: Schedules tasks to delete an article identified by args[0].
